blocks.prompt: 5 (i) Consider a signal processing system represented by the polynomial \(S(x) = 2x^3 - 5x^2 + 4x - 3\), where \(x\) is the input to the system. If the input to the system is \(x = 2\), find the remainder.
blocks.explanation:
Input \(x = 2\) par "remainder find karo" ka matlab Remainder Theorem hai: \(S(x)\) ko \(x - 2\) se divide karein to remainder \(S(2)\) hota hai.
Diya kya hai? \(S(x) = 2x^3 - 5x^2 + 4x - 3\) aur input \(x = 2\).
Find kya karna hai? Sirf ek number, remainder.
Plan: \(x = 2\) rakh kar \(S(2)\) nikalein, phir synthetic division se tasdeeq.
Note karein: kitab mein is exercise ka Sawal 4 hai hi nahi; numbering 3 ke baad seedha 5 par chali jati hai. Is liye yeh hamara chautha sawal hai, lekin naam wahi "Question 5" rakha hai jo kitab mein chhapa hai, taake kitab se milana aasaan rahe.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S(x) = 2x^3 - 5x^2 + 4x - 3\), input \(x = 2\).
Humein find karna hai: remainder.
Tareeqa: Remainder Theorem: \(S(x)\) ko \(x - a\) se divide karein to remainder \(S(a)\) hota hai. Yahan \(a = 2\). Is ka faida yeh hai ke poori division kiye baghair remainder mil jata hai.

\(S(2)\) nikalein
\[S(2) = 2(2)^3 - 5(2)^2 + 4(2) - 3\]
\[= 2(8) - 5(4) + 8 - 3\]
\[= 16 - 20 + 8 - 3\]
\[= 1\]
Kyun: Pehle powers: \(2^3 = 8\), \(2^2 = 4\). Phir coefficients se multiply: \(2 \times 8 = 16\), \(5 \times 4 = 20\), \(4 \times 2 = 8\). Phir baen se daen: \(16 - 20 = -4\), \(-4 + 8 = 4\), \(4 - 3 = 1\).
Dhyan dein: \(2(2)^3\) ko \((2 \times 2)^3 = 64\) mat banaiye; power sirf andar wale 2 par hai.
Signal processing ki zabaan mein \(S(2) = 1\) ka matlab hai ke input 2 dene par system ka output 1 hai. Yahi remainder kehlata hai.

Synthetic division se tasdeeq (\(x - 2\) se)
Coefficients \(2,\ -5,\ 4,\ -3\), \(a = 2\):
2 neeche utarein; \(2 \times 2 = 4\), \(-5 + 4 = -1\);
\(-1 \times 2 = -2\), \(4 - 2 = 2\);
\(2 \times 2 = 4\), \(-3 + 4 = 1\).
\[\text{Quotient} = 2x^2 - x + 2\]
\[\text{Remainder} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Seedhi division bhi wahi remainder 1 deti hai. Dono tareeqe ek hi jawab dein to ghalti ka imkaan bahut kam reh jata hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) For the same system \(S(x) = 2x^3 - 5x^2 + 4x - 3\), determine whether the system has a specific characteristic such that when \(x = 1\), the system response becomes zero. If so, identify the factor.
blocks.explanation:
"\(x = 1\) par response zero ho jaye" ka matlab \(S(1) = 0\). Factor Theorem ke mutabiq aisa tab hi hota hai jab \(x - 1\) factor ho.
Find kya karna hai? Haan ya na; agar haan to factor ka naam.
Plan: \(S(1)\) nikalein; zero aaye to factor \(x - 1\), warna aisa koi factor nahi.
Part (i) mein humne value nikali thi; yahan humein faisla karna hai ke value zero hai ya nahi. Dono parts mein tool ek hi hai, bas sawal ka rukh badla hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: wahi \(S(x) = 2x^3 - 5x^2 + 4x - 3\), ab input \(x = 1\).
Humein find karna hai: kya \(S(1) = 0\)? Agar haan to factor batana hai.
Tareeqa: \(x = 1\) par system ka response \(S(1)\) hai. Factor Theorem: \(x - 1\) factor hai agar aur sirf agar \(S(1) = 0\).

\(S(1)\) nikalein
\[S(1) = 2(1)^3 - 5(1)^2 + 4(1) - 3\]
\[= 2 - 5 + 4 - 3\]
\[= -2\]
Kyun: 1 ki har power 1 hi hoti hai (\(1^3 = 1\), \(1^2 = 1\)), is liye har term sirf apna coefficient reh jata hai. Yaad rakhein: \(P(1)\) hamesha coefficients ka jama hota hai. Phir \(2 - 5 = -3\), \(-3 + 4 = 1\), \(1 - 3 = -2\).

Natija nikalein
\[S(1) = -2 \neq 0\]
Kyun: \(x = 1\) par response \(-2\) hai, zero nahi. Is liye system mein yeh khaas characteristic nahi hai, aur Factor Theorem ke mutabiq \(x - 1\) factor nahi. Sawal kehta hai "if so, identify the factor"; chunke jawab "na" hai, koi factor batana nahi.
Dhyan dein: sirf is liye ke sawal factor poochh raha hai, zabardasti \(x - 1\) ko factor mat likhiye. Pehle test, phir faisla.
Hamari taraf se misaal: agar polynomial \(2x^3 - 5x^2 + 4x - 1\) hota to \(S(1) = 2 - 5 + 4 - 1 = 0\) aata, aur tab hum keh sakte ke \(x - 1\) factor hai.

Synthetic division se tasdeeq (\(a = 1\))
Coefficients \(2,\ -5,\ 4,\ -3\):
2 neeche utarein; \(2 - 5 = -3\); \(-3 + 4 = 1\); \(1 - 3 = -2\).
\[\text{Quotient} = 2x^2 - 3x + 1\]
\[\text{Remainder} = -2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a = 1\) ho to har multiplication number ko wahi ka wahi rehne deti hai, is liye division bahut jaldi ho jati hai aur wahi remainder \(-2\) deti hai.
blocks.final_answer: Nahi. \(S(1) = -2 \neq 0\), is liye \(x = 1\) par response zero nahi aur \(x - 1\) factor nahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Numbering: kitab is exercise ke sawal 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 chhapti hai; Sawal 4 maujood hi nahi, is liye yeh exercise ka chautha sawal hai. Answer key (PDF 307) mein is ke jawab number 6 par hain: "(i) Remainder = 1 (ii) System response in not zero when \(x = 1\)" ("in" asal mein "is" hona chahiye). Dono hamare hal se milte hain. Key ka number 5, "CRC = 20", kisi chhape hue sawal ka nahi.
